block.guhs.hamsterknooppunt.lore: The main station of your hamster tube network. Runs on vadskracht and fills a buffer; every trip costs %s VK (buffer: %s VK). Without vadskracht your whole network stands still, njeg.
block.guhs.hamsterknooppunt.nieuw: This is your Hamster Junction now! Run a guh wire to it and the hamster tubes start rolling.
block.guhs.hamsterknooppunt.verhuisd: Your Hamster Junction moved here. The old one does nothing any more.
block.guhs.hamsterknooppunt.niet_meer: This is not (or no longer) your Hamster Junction. A newer one stands somewhere.
block.guhs.hamsterknooppunt.stand: Hamster Junction: %s / %s VK in the buffer, a trip costs %s VK. Stations in your network: %s.
block.guhs.hamsterbuis_station.lore: Put it anywhere, in any dimension. Step into the tube and pick where to go: whoosh! Needs no vadskracht itself, your Hamster Junction pays (%s VK per trip).
block.guhs.hamsterbuis_station.geen_knoo: This station is registered, but you have no Hamster Junction yet. Without a junction nothing rolls.
block.guhs.hamsterbuis_station.niet_van_: This is someone else's hamster tube. Ask if you may (dream cloud friends always may)!
block.guhs.hamsterbuis_station.weg: That station doesn't exist any more. It was taken out of the network.
block.guhs.hamsterbuis_station.stil: The hamster tube network stands still: the junction's buffer has less than %s VK. Give the junction vadskracht!
gui.guhs.hamsterbuis.openbaar.tooltip: Public: everyone may travel with this station. Private: only you and your dream cloud friends.
gui.guhs.hamsterbuis.ga_stil: The network of %s stands still (%s): the junction has too little vadskracht.
gui.guhs.hamsterbuis.geen_knooppunt: No Hamster Junction: this network stands still.
gui.guhs.hamsterbuis.geen: No other stations yet. Put another one down, somewhere far away, and come back!
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.tech_hamsterknooppun: Build a &dHamster Junction&r and run a guh wire to it. It fills a buffer with vadskracht: that keeps all your hamster tubes rolling. One per guh owner!
ftb.guhs_techniek.q.tech_hamsterbuis_sta: Place two &dhamster tube stations&r, far apart (another dimension is fine!). Step into the tube, pick where to go, and whoosh!
